Проекция спина на фиксированную ось $z$ — ещё не спиральность: нужно знать,
в какую сторону летела частица. Сравним два направления вылета фотона.

```{=html}
<div class="photon-story-axis"><b>толстая стрелка — спин</b><span>\(+z\)</span><i></i></div>
<div class="photon-story-cases" aria-label="Одна спиральность нейтрино допускает две спиральности фотона при разных направлениях его вылета">
  <div class="photon-story-case story-forward">
    <span class="photon-story-number">1</span>
    <div class="photon-story-node">

    </div>

    <div class="photon-story-node source">
      <span class="photon-story-ball nucleus">\(A\)</span>
      <span class="photon-story-caption">\(A+e^-\)</span>
    </div>
    <span class="photon-story-space"></span>
    <div class="photon-story-node">
      <span class="photon-story-ball nucleus excited">\(B^*\)</span>
      <span class="photon-story-spin nucleus left"><i></i></span>
      <span class="photon-story-momentum right"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_{B^*}\)</b></span>
    </div>
    <div class="photon-story-products aligned-products">
      <div class="photon-story-product photon">
        <div class="photon-story-node">
          <span class="photon-story-ball photon">\(\gamma\)</span>
          <span class="photon-story-spin photon left"><i></i></span>
          <span class="photon-story-momentum right"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_\gamma\)</b></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="photon-story-product">
        <div class="photon-story-node">
          <span class="photon-story-ball nucleus ground">\(B\)</span>
          <span class="photon-story-momentum right"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_B\)</b></span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="photon-story-result">\(h_\nu=-1\)<br>\(h_\gamma=-1\)</div>
  </div>

  <div class="photon-story-case story-reverse">
    <span class="photon-story-number">2</span>
    <div class="photon-story-node">
      <span class="photon-story-ball nucleus excited">\(B^*\)</span>
      <span class="photon-story-spin nucleus right"><i></i></span>
      <span class="photon-story-momentum left"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_{B^*}\)</b></span>
    </div>
    <div class="photon-story-products aligned-products">
      <div class="photon-story-product photon">
        <div class="photon-story-node">
          <span class="photon-story-ball photon">\(\gamma\)</span>
          <span class="photon-story-spin photon right"><i></i></span>
          <span class="photon-story-momentum right separate-from-spin"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_\gamma\)</b></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="photon-story-product">
        <div class="photon-story-node">
          <span class="photon-story-ball nucleus ground">\(B\)</span>
          <span class="photon-story-momentum left"><i></i><b>\(\mathbf p_B\)</b></span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <span class="photon-story-space"></span>
    <div class="photon-story-node source">
      <span class="photon-story-ball nucleus">\(A\)</span>
      <span class="photon-story-caption">\(A+e^-\)</span>

```

::: {.nh-box tone="warning" size="md" align="center" weight="bold"}

Одна и та же спиральность нейтрино допускает обе спиральности фотона.
Нужно отобрать фотоны по направлению относительно отдачи $B^*$.

:::
